Dave Matthews Band
July 26, 2008
Verizon Wireless Music Center
Noblesville, Indiana

Taper: Chris Drews
Source: AT853s > SP-XLRM-MINI-2 (48v phantom power) > UA-5 (w-mod) > iRiver iHP-120 (Rockbox)
Location: Section C, Row N, Seats 1 & 2, clamped to Crumbo
Editing: WAV > Audacity 2.3.2 (Gain, Mixing, Normalizing, Fades, Tracking) > FLAC (Level 8)

Setlist:

02. One Sweet World
03. Granny
04. Grey Street

06. Pantala Naga Pampa >
07. Rapunzel
08. What Would You Say

10. Out of My Hands
11. Everyday&
12. Crash into Me$
13. Lie in Our Graves
14. Money# >
15. Money (That's What I Want)@
16. Crush
17. Anyone Seen the Bridge! >
18. Too Much (Fake) > Ants Marching?
19. Encore Break
20. Sister (> Little Thing (Tease))
21. Gravedigger
22. Thank You (Falettinme Be Mice Elf Agin)%

Dave Matthews Band:

Dave Matthews - Guitar, Lead Vocals
Tim Reynolds - Electric Guitar
Stefan Lessard - Bass
Boyd Tinsley - Violin
Rashawn Ross - Trumpet, Vocals
Jeff Coffin - Saxophone, Flute
Carter Beauford - Drums

Notes:

* Intro is missing approx. 20 secs, begins just before the song kicks in.
^ with Why I Am outro
& with You Can't Rollerskate in a Buffalo Herd interpolation
$ with Dixie Chicken interpolation
# Pink Floyd cover
@ Barret Strong cover
! with Also Sprach Zarathustra and Funk #49 interpolations
? direct intro; Shake Your Body (Down to the Ground) interpolation
% Sly and the Family Stone cover

LeRoi Moore did not play at this show due to injury.
